name: news-feed
description: Daily news digest: the news-feed skill writes content/data/, web/ renders it.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix .claude/skills/news-feed/scripts && npm ci --prefix web && ([ -e content/source.json ] || (mkdir -p content && cp source.example.json content/source.json))
scripts.build: sh scripts/fetch-content.sh && ([ -d web/node_modules ] || npm ci --prefix web) && TZ="${TZ:-Australia/Sydney}" npm run build --prefix web
